title: Use for 4 x 4 pole all pass
text: what is the intended purpose of Steve Harris' 4 x 4 pole all pass plugin? I put it on a master buss and was immediately confused by the parameters. There seem to be 4 buckets or bands each with a feedback dial. But unlike EQ dials these dials seem to put signal from the back into the channel whether the input is negative or positive, so that -6 and +6 give feedback.

title: Is there a difference between rendering audio to MP3 versus converting audio from a WAV to MP3?
text: Someone has exported an audio project as a WAV for me, but I need it to be an MP3 for distribution. Will the end product be any different if I re-export the audio as an MP3 versus converting the audio from a WAV to an MP3 (using VLC or similar tool)? For a couple of reasons re-exporting is not trivial so I was curious what the differences might be if any. This is a similar question but the reverse situation (I think): Is exporting to WAV and converting from MP3 to WAV the same thing? There they are going from lossy to lossless, but here it is lossless to lossy.
